thread:
Maya Chen: Horizon RFI landed. They need capability matrix, security answers, POC timeline, pricing, and HSM/network appendix. Can we split up?

Evan Ortiz: I can own security + arch diagrams. They asked BYOK vs on-prem HSM. I'll attach standard HSM doc.

Sophie Patel: I'll draft POC commercial proposal. Recommend 3-month reserved with option to scale after month 1 — better economics.

Kim (sales-eng): I'll assemble capability matrix. Items flagged: latency SLA, model pinning, audit logs, private control plane, quantization. Drop extras here.

Maya Chen: @Evan please pull private-deploy diagram (VPC peering, HSM placement). @Sophie include billing note: first month upfront, rest net30 unless reserved.

deploy-bot: New file uploaded by Evan Ortiz: https://drive.redwood/horizon/arch-vpc-hsm.pdf

Evan Ortiz: HSM note for RFI: support cloud KMS (AWS/Azure) with HSM-backed keys; for air-gapped on-prem HSM we provide integration guide + install support.

Legal - Nora: For RFI provide high-level security boilerplate: SOC2 Type II, annual pentest, FedRAMP readiness on roadmap (no firm ETA). Contract specifics later.

Sophie Patel: Ballpark pricing to include in draft: Dedicated POC (4 GPU equiv) ~$28k/mo; Private deployment packaging ~$45k one-time; HSM integration support ~$8k one-time.

Kim (sales-eng): Quick asks: confirm model family (they said open foundation models) and p90 latency target (they want ~150ms). I'll mark latency as "partial" for hosted, "committed" for dedicated.

Maya Chen: Owners recap: Evan = security + diagrams; Sophie = pricing + POC text; Kim = capability matrix; Nora = legal boilerplate. I'll assemble bundle and send once Evan's final docs are in.

Sophie Patel: Will deliver pricing sheet and POC term language by EOD tomorrow.

Evan Ortiz: Final HSM wording + diagram by 09:00 tomorrow.

Maya Chen: Thanks team — drop any perf logs or test results in the drive and @me.
